text:
alex: kicking off staged rollout -> 10% traffic to inference-api v1.34.0 now. change window 23:00-01:00 PST.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started r-2026-04-01-1741294321 -> target=10% v1.34.0
maria: seeing a small but notable jump in 502s in eu-west-1 around 23:03 UTC (~0.9% of requests).
june: can you paste a couple of error samples?
maria: logs snippet: ```ERROR: kv cache miss overflow at attention layer
trace id=tx-77b9
status=502
stack=libattention.so+0x1f4a```
sre-oncall: running quick health checks now, pulling pod statuses and recent restarts
sre-oncall: `kubectl get pods -l app=inference-api -o wide` -> 2/3 new v1.34.0 pods show RestartCount>0, older pods (v1.33.2) stable
alex: ok let's STOP any further ramping. do not increase beyond 10% until we triage. @maria @june agree?
june: agree, freeze ramp. propose rolling back eu-west-1 slice to v1.33.2 while keeping global at 10% to collect cross-region signal
deploy-bot: ACTION_REQUIRED: to revert region eu-west-1 run: `deployctl revert --service=inference-api --region=eu-west-1 --to-version=v1.33.2`
maria: i will execute eu-west-1 rollback in ~2m, will post progress. holding on global changes.
alex: also add routing pin for eu-west-1 to prevent automated retrying into v1.34.0 until we clear postmortem
maria: running revert now (23:05 UTC). command output:
```
action=rollback start
service=inference-api
region=eu-west-1
from=v1.34.0 -> to=v1.33.2
job=id-rb-1741294321
```
sre-oncall: watching metrics: error rate falling in eu-west-1 after rollback, p50 latency stable. will keep monitoring 10m
june: please update release notes / CS with a short blurb: small region rollback due to transient 502s, investigation ongoing
deploy-bot: rollback job id-rb-1741294321 completed successfully. health-check: passed (5m window). label=rollout:paused
alex: thanks. pin done?
maria: pinned routing for eu-west-1 -> v1.33.2: `routectl pin --service inference-api --region eu-west-1 --version v1.33.2` -> done
alex: OK — rollout is paused globally. we'll regroup in 30m with telemetry and decide next steps (retest, fix, or proceed).
